premises.text: Community organizers currently juggle multiple separate platforms for events, email, and members—members must sign up for many systems
premises.evidence_span: I've had to use five platforms to stay organized

premises.text: Cohort is a single umbrella for communication, event, member, and transaction management for any community type
premises.evidence_span: the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership

premises.text: Organizer tools include email lists tied to discussion boards, member directory/profiles, custom join forms, advanced ticketing, and dues/fees without handling cash
premises.evidence_span: Each organizer is given robust communication management tools

premises.text: Hierarchical chapters/subgroups get full toolsets with autonomous local leadership plus global comms/events
premises.evidence_span: Each group can have as many subgroups as they want and as many tiers of subgroups as they need

premises.text: Social group interaction, interest channels for discovery, and public/private/hidden privacy toggles
premises.evidence_span: We've also created something new called channels

premises.text: Most groups free; revenue from channel subscriptions, premium group subscriptions, and transaction service fees
premises.evidence_span: for the vast majority of groups, it's entirely free

value.text: Connect community—one solution for organizers to engage membership

secondary_value.text: Unify entrepreneurial ecosystem and export entrepreneurship globally via university chapters
secondary_value.evidence_span: unify the entire entrepreneurial ecosystem and export entrepreneurship globally

causal_links.evidence_span: managing those organizations has been incredibly challenging
